Detected anticipation pattern derived from dog-linked sensor/ELI processing; technical privacy classification only.

Founder decision Behavioral-C: rows with administration_mode='research' are governed by separate research/validation authority; standardized/progressive/unknown product rows follow behavioral_assessment_product lifecycle. Physical table sharing does not merge the two purposes.

Rows contain exact latitude/longitude plus dog-pair and occurrence time; the raw persisted row is therefore governed by the high-risk exact-location boundary. Any longer-lived social/co-presence history must use a separately governed de-located derived representation.

Versioned behavioral-derived ELI prior; product/research provenance remains separately controlled.

Owner- and dog-linked recipient binding/contact, declared purpose/scope, access-window and lifecycle metadata for professional sharing. This classifies persistence only; it does not authorize recipient activation or final retention.

Daily derived routine-state index and trend, not raw sensor persistence.
Versioned deterministic TAG-derived movement-feature observations. This is preprocessed physical sensor data, not latent ELI or an affective interpretation.

Canonical World trust-ladder state between two accounts (pending, connected, declined, directional trust flags); no score, message, dog or location data.

Owner-scoped World reward ledger with bounded event/source identifiers and server-owned grant vectors; lifecycle/export authority remains unresolved.
Owner-scoped World inventory with item id, coarse region code and build timestamp; lifecycle/export authority remains unresolved.
Owner-scoped World build spend ledger with bounded item/idempotency identifiers and cost vectors; lifecycle/export authority remains unresolved.

scopeLimitations: This first-order registry is independent from technical lineage completeness.
Transitive behavioral descendants are controlled by dog-erasure topology but are not silently classified here.
Mapped does not establish legal basis, retention, exportability, erasure mode or production approval.
Unclassified is an explicit blocker, not a conclusion that the persistence is unlawful.
Technical mapping to sensor_preprocessed or eli_inferred does not choose detailed-vs-aggregate retention, row-level trigger semantics, erasure disposition, or legal basis.
